claims.claim: The POST action is marked [HttpPost("{orderId}/updateStatus")]. Its controller method forwards a command containing orderId and request.StatusId to the updateCustomerOrderStatusCommandHandler.Handle receiver; a matching AddScoped registration and handler declaration are also present in the packet. These are source-level delegation, registration, and declaration observations: the packet leaves receiver and DI type binding unresolved, so it does not establish runtime dispatch across those files.

In the handler method source, the order status is assigned command.StatusId and Updated is assigned DateTime.UtcNow; dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken) is awaited before eventLink is initialized and before the response constructor is called.

The handler initializes eventLink to null. It assigns a URL only when command.StatusId is 6 and both TourTimeSlotsId and TimeSlotDate have values; the URL uses _options.PublicAppBaseUrl.TrimEnd('/') followed by /customer/images/{slot id}/{date formatted yyyy-MM-dd}. The response constructor receives eventLink, CustomerCheckoutSupport.ResolveHomepageLink(order.TourTimeSlot!.Tour!, _options), and the raw order.TourTimeSlot.Tour!.HomepageUrl as successive URL-related arguments.

The response constructor receives, in order, eventLink, CustomerCheckoutSupport.ResolveHomepageLink(order.TourTimeSlot!.Tour!, _options), and the raw order.TourTimeSlot.Tour!.HomepageUrl.
question: For POST api/customer/{orderId}/updateStatus, what is saved before the response, when is eventLink populated, and which URL values are passed to the response constructor?
